name: trip-viewer-firebase
description: Trip Viewer â€” Firebase-hosted static frontend

scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('dist/ cleaned.');"
scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "8085,9099,5000,5001,4000,8787,8788 | ForEach-Object { $p = $_; $procs = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -ne 0 } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($procs) { foreach ($procId in $procs) { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Killed process on port $p" } else { Write-Host "Port $p is free" } }"
scripts.dev: node scripts/dev/ensure-ports-free.js && concurrently -n fn-watch,front-watch,emulators,open,worker,gmaps -c yellow,blue,green,magenta,cyan,white "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "npm run watch" "node scripts/dev/start-emulator.js" "node scripts/utils/open-on-ready.js" "npm --prefix worker run dev" "npm run gmaps:server"
scripts.functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
